claims_in_fragment: malloc_trim after each generate returns approximately 379 MB.
malloc_trim is an O(1) free-list pass typically below 0.1 ms.

observed.scope: single idle-window/resume cycle, 3 trimmed + 3 control processes; not full coordinated 10-node fabric

project_measurement_comparison.reason: The measured trim effect is substantial but approximately 97 MB, not a demonstrated ~379 MB return; the project measurement also does not establish the fragment's sub-millisecond trim/wake constants.

malloc_trim.supported: malloc_trim attempts to release free heap memory; return value reports whether memory was actually released.

madvise.supported: MADV_FREE exists on Linux and marks eligible pages as no longer required.
madvise.critical_constraint: MADV_FREE applies only to private anonymous pages; after pages are actually freed, later references observe zero-fill-on-demand pages.
madvise.implication: The fragment's broad claim that Shared_Clean model-weight pages can be MADV_FREE'd and transparently faulted back as unchanged weights is not established and is structurally incompatible with MADV_FREE's documented mapping/contents semantics unless a different eligible anonymous-memory design is proven.

audit_result.falsifier: Exact admitted runtime evidence at current source identity reproduces the fragment's approximately-379-MB release, sub-0.1-ms trim, 2-8-ms wake, and safe model-weight MADV_FREE behavior under the claimed mapping type.

claims_in_fragment: Initial tests reduced Private_Dirty from ~379 MB to <50 MB/process.

project_evidence_state.finding: Current repository search found a controlled malloc_trim A/B receipt, but no exact MADV_FREE experiment receipt supporting the <50 MB/process, <3 GB GRID10, or single-digit-ms claims.
project_evidence_state.known_controlled_measurement: malloc_trim-only measurement reached ~279.2 MB/process after idle, not <50 MB/process.

external_primary_comparison.constraint: MADV_FREE is limited to private anonymous mappings and can discard stale data; once freed, subsequent reads see zero-filled pages until rewritten.

audit_result.falsifier: A source/hash-bound experiment demonstrates the claimed MADV_FREE memory floor, latency and full ten-process GRID10 correctness under an eligible mapping design.
